interactions.author: usalu
interactions.prompt: Refactor docstring and section comment format to enforce: (1) Sections use regular comments, definitions use native docstrings (JSDoc for TS/JS, triple-quote for Python, XML doc for C#, /// for Rust, // for Go). (2) No blank lines between region marker and comments/docstrings. (3) One blank line between definitions/sections. (4) Section format: identification first, summary second, specs, TODOs, docs. (5) Definition docstring format: summary first, specs, TODOs, identification last. (6) Implement policies, autofix, tests for all languages. Fix all breachs to 0.
